entities.title: Swarmhold Godot client
entities.summary: The game in Godot 4.7 (GDScript, Compatibility renderer for WebGL 2): the generated walled city, the player, the hostage, the ants, grenades, effects, camera and HUD, all built in code without imported assets apart from the Montserrat font.
entities.purpose: Everything the player sees and plays. main.gd runs the game and owns the camera and spawning; the other scripts each own one part, as the component diagram shows. Run with -- --autotest it plays three levels through headless (rescue, ants, grenades, the exit) and quits with a failing status on any miss, which is the game's test (npm run test:godot).
boundaries: Talks to nothing: no server API, no storage. The Worker only serves it.
web_shell/ is the page template for the export and is left out of the pack.
